blurb: ChicaGo By Boat offers private powerboat cruises on Lake Michigan and the Chicago River aboard a Downeast style boat. Charters are private and for a set period of time booked by the customer. The vessels carry a maximum of six passengers and children 12 and under must wear a USCG approved personal flotation device and be accompanied by an adult 1:1 on weekdays.
extraNote: Payment due at time of booking, online only · Changes or cancellations must be made in writing by original charterer · Full refund if cancelled more than 7 days before departure · 33% forfeited if cancelled within 7 days of departure · No refund or extension if passengers are late or do not arrive · Charter terminated with no refund if guest is overly intoxicated or uses recreational drugs · No smoking on board; electronic cigarettes and vaporizers allowed · No swimming allowed
